summary: Hailing works. The paid and member-only functions are the ones that ask.

items.task: Hailing a taxi in the app
items.note: Users on foreign country codes appear in Kakao Mobility's own material. A foreign number is not a bar to hailing.

items.task: Automatic payment, financial features, some memberships
items.note: Kakao Mobility's privacy policy states that identity verification collects name, carrier, mobile number, date of birth, Korean or foreign national status, and CI/DI.
Routes for foreign and non-member purchasers exist, so a blanket 'no Korean number means no mobile ticket' is wrong. What narrows is member functions and simple payment.

source: Kakao Mobility privacy policy; rail operators' non-member and foreign purchase routes
